why: A biped skeleton in a blob's slot: the looks pilot's moss-mole came back from Meshy's auto-rig on a humanoid skeleton (a hand weighted to nothing, a face torn in two clips), the only rig a legless critter could get before the body archetypes (looks wave 2, 2026-10-14). Here the stand-in is the kit's own bean (gf-humanoid-1) put in the blob role's body slot. Gate A must fail it: the slot asks for gf-blob-1.
